_doc: Rosace sprite palette (docs/character/DESIGN.md section 4, revision 2): 29 colours. 'colors' is the palette; 'materials' maps each render material to its toon ramp (codes, dark -> light: deep, shadow, lit, highlight), the band thresholds on lit value, the outline colour (line) and the lit-side selective outline (selout). 'inner' is the colour for inner/overlap lines. 'spec' is a view-space highlight band (code, threshold on N.H). Build and post-process read this file; edit colours here only.
_round4fix: Round 4 value plan (craft / overall / gear critics: 70% light values, no dark mass framing the face, legs merge into the tabard, the chest shows flat W4 masses): hair ramp one step down (I3 core 0.14 -> 0.22, I2 0.40 -> 0.54, I1 0.80 -> 0.86) so the head has a dark frame; white cloth W4 only for real occlusion (0.20 -> 0.13) and more W1 (0.66 -> 0.62); thigh-highs one more step down to the lavender W3 core (W2 0.46 -> 0.62, W1 sheen 0.94) with an I4 inner line where the tabard or the other leg crosses them; haft shadow side one step darker (I4 0.12 -> 0.26, I3 0.40 -> 0.56).
_round3fix: Round 3 value plan (craft / gear / overall critics: bodice, tabard and thigh-highs merged into one white mass; hair brighter than the face): stocking lit band one step down (W1 only above 0.9 plus the W1 sheen spec, W3 core 0.10 -> 0.22, W2 0.28 -> 0.46) so the legs read as a cooler, darker surface than the white tabard; hair I1 band 0.66 -> 0.80 and I2 0.36 -> 0.40 so the hair mass drops toward I2/I3 and the face is the brightest value on the head.
_round2: Round 2 value plan (critics: 80% of the body high value, no core shadow): white shadow family pushed 1 step darker (t 0.14/0.31/0.56 -> 0.20/0.42/0.66), skin core-shadow band wider (S3 0.36 -> 0.42, S1 0.64 -> 0.72), boot spec removed (scattered I0 specks), haft spec widened to a continuous I1 spine line so the thinner haft reads on dark backgrounds.
